results.name: The catalogue contains 60 species, 10 unique bosses, 100 items and 3 complete classes
Every generated room is reachable, reciprocal and contains only its biome encounters
Floor routes, loops, room architecture and all ten events vary reproducibly
Instant event choices enforce their costs and apply permanent run boons only once
Ambushes, the empowered duel and the three-wave bell award their offerings after victory
The timed vault has real warnings, sealed exits and a continuing timer after save and resize
An interrupted bell wave restores its living enemies and never duplicates its reward
Room furnishing preserves a clear route to each available door at four portrait heights
One hundred floors descend in order and enter an ending after the tenth boss
Melee strikes respect facing, consume stamina and do not hit the same target twice
The seer fires a real damaging projectile after anticipation
Guard direction and dodge invulnerability reject damage only while valid
All ordinary species and all boss patterns produce finite, telegraphed attacks
Each skill spends focus, respects cooldowns and acts on the encounter
Equipment changes statistics and cannot be salvaged while worn or used by another class
Seeded item quality and affixes reproduce and all 100 items have usable data
Leaving and revisiting a room preserves enemy health and chest flags
Saving restores progress, gear, skill ranks and resized positions without spawning foes again
Corrupt, dead and foreign save data is rejected
The six tutorial steps require their corresponding real controls
Death finishes once and a completed run never serializes as resumable
Physical descents vary in side and form and require approach to the actual shaft
A saved anticipation resumes once, while a completed cast never spends focus again
Melee pursuit routes around a pool and sorcery crosses it while stone cover blocks shots
A 3.0 descent restores its original graph and continues into the new branching floors
A released fallen star survives Continue and lands once; wards retain their remaining duration
